summary: First working application slice after owner-approved implementation start: app/ with SQLite storage, OpenAlex source adapters, TF-IDF/Rocchio/MMR ranking, a single budgeted model gateway, the daily 5-card loop, feedback semantics, PDF download, optional AI triage, a loopback web UI and a headless CLI. 82 tests pass; one real DeepSeek triage call succeeded and was ledgered. Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit f16b070. New app package + tests + docs/registry; one real model call (~$0.0011).

budget_impact.rationale: The app now contains a runtime model path (daily_triage via the single gateway) which was exercised once for $0.0010608 / 1469 tokens. Ceilings and prices are unchanged; the ledger lives in .local and the call is recorded. This is a first slice, not a passing budget gate.
budget_impact.before: No runtime application; model calls only in offline probes.
budget_impact.after: Runtime path exists behind app/gateway.py with reserve-then-send accounting; one triage call recorded; enforcement still not implemented for concurrency/restart.

additional_checks.scope: Cards generated from the local DB
Loopback UI serves the page and five cards

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; first working slice, not a release

open_risks: Labelling prompt seed-title bias unfixed; evaluation numbers are not product evidence.
No Tauri shell/packaging; OpenAlex 429s can make refresh unreliable.
Budget gateway untested near ceilings or across restart with unknown usage.
No Zotero import, notes/highlights, follow-up QA or export UI yet.
